svg.text: Restarted on the main account. Small zone fix pushed; full checks running on
it. Part 4 is rechecking its 3 reference cars; the frozen version gets tagged
Time-accurate runs now work; four cars (two from each drag level) running for
about eleven flow-passes to see whether the wake switches. Mesh-reshape fix
Checking whether the car map is steady across the flow's swings (main account
Rechecking the 3 reference cars on the body builder's latest code; a pass lets
it freeze its version for the counted runs.
Waiting for the go to start this phase.
Each square is one piece of work or one test case. Green: done. Red: failed, being redone. Grey: still to do. Counted from each part's progress file.
